title: Miami 42ft Yacht Rental with 2 Free Jet Ski
blurb:
IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT AN ALL-INCLUSIVE OFFER.

Additional fees paid separately to third parties:
• Marina Pick-Up Fee: $200
• Fuel Fee: $100/hr
• Crew Payment: $100/hr

Per US Coast Guard bareboat charter regulations, these fees must be paid directly to third parties and cannot pass through our hands, as this would be illegal.

Set sail on a private 42-foot yacht charter in Miami, perfect for groups seeking both relaxation and adventure. Enjoy a cruise past the stunning Miami skyline while having the option to hop on included jet skis for some exhilarating fun. This flexible experience allows you to shape your outing to match your interests and pace, making it ideal for families and friends alike.

- Cruise the Miami River and enjoy picturesque views from the yacht
- Jet skis included at no extra cost for charters of four hours or more
- Includes amenities like bottled water, ice, and a Bluetooth sound system
